# Google AI Overviews Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/google-ai-overviews-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/google-ai-overviews-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.66**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Google AI Overviews for any search query. Extract the AI Overview answer and cited sources as JSON, CSV, or Excel. Track AI search visibility, monitor brand citations, and run AEO and GEO reports in any country or language. Connect your AI agents via MCP. No code needed.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Actor Start $0.00005, Google AI Overview $0.003 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/google-ai-overviews-scraper) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      queries: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | string | yes |  | Search query/queries — The queries to look up on Google. For each one, the AI Overview shown on the results page (if any) is returned. Enter one query per line. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
